title: GGF Implementation & Adaptation Framework
legal_character: Implementation-support, method-selection, pilot, transition, and learning interface; not a source of jurisdiction, consent, public law, emergency command, funding authority, or scaling permission.
non_authority_clause: Context is not competence. Assessment is not jurisdiction. A tool is not a mandate. Adoption is not activation. Pilot success is not permission to scale. Compatibility is not legitimacy. Conformance is not success.

pilot_types.primary_question: Can affected participants understand, access, and willingly use the intervention?
pilot_types.success_supports: Acceptability within the tested population and conditions

pilot_types.primary_question: Can the intervention operate safely with the tested resources and constraints?
Does the claimed causal mechanism operate under specified conditions?
Can authorized ordinary actors deliver the intervention reliably?
Does the relevant condition improve, including distributional and external effects?
Can a competent ordinary owner maintain, adapt, fund, govern, and close the function after exceptional support ends?
pilot_types.success_supports: Durability within the tested institutional context

complexity_bands.authority_consequence: None; appropriate internal authority and consent still required.
None; cumulative dependency and administrative-burden review required.
None; public or protected-domain effects require specialized authority.
No automatic progression; new jurisdiction and authorization required.

consequence_profiles.name: Exploratory and non-consequential
consequence_profiles.examples: public education, optional brainstorming, non-operative drafting, simulation, or demonstration.
consequence_profiles.core: one compact non-operative record identifying the method or artifact, responsible actor, authority effect, and non-activation status. Data and closure semantics are added where material.

consequence_profiles.name: Voluntary bounded practice
consequence_profiles.core: actor and method; voluntary scope; consent, refusal, and withdrawal; implementation responsibility; stop and expiry; complaint and correction route.

consequence_profiles.name: Operational or consequential action
consequence_profiles.core: constituting authority; affected parties; causal responsibility; authorization and activation; implementation ownership and dependencies; monitoring and review; challenge and remedy; closure and unresolved-duty custody.

consequence_profiles.name: Protected-domain or constitutional action
consequence_profiles.core: `CP2` plus `GMEAIA-56` or `GMEAIA-57` and the controlling specialized interface. Ordinary GMEAIA conformance is never sufficient by itself.

records.minimum_controls: human accountable officer; access class; affected-party references; authority, activation, challenge, expiry, closure, unresolved-duty, and prohibited-inference fields; correction propagation where relied upon.

records.title: Urgent Context, Emergency Signal, CDEE Referral, Mission Acceptance, and Quick-Start Boundary
records.authority_effect_rule: Must be explicitly recorded; default is `advisory` or `record_support` unless a cited competent record supplies another effect.
records.purpose: Allows rapid listening, immediate support, EGP sense records, and CDEE referrals. A 48-hour target is operational only. Emergency declaration, command, information access, finance, deployment, renewal, and termination require ECRC/CDEE and competent authority.
records.minimum_controls: human accountable officer; access class; affected-party references; authority, activation, challenge, expiry, closure, unresolved-duty, and prohibited-inference fields; correction propagation where relied upon.

records.title: Cross-Framework Handoff, Response Duty, Recipient State, Custody, and Conformance
records.authority_effect_rule: Must be explicitly recorded; default is `advisory` or `record_support` unless a cited competent record supplies another effect.
records.purpose: Identifies the exact receiving framework, version, record, responsibility, response-duty source and effect, acknowledgment and decision clocks, offered scope, GMEAIA response state, capacity limitations, provisional safe-state reference, acceptance or refusal, post-acceptance action clock, custody, sender duties, expiry, correction, escalation, and return. Referral does not merge jurisdiction or erase prior duties.
records.minimum_controls: human accountable officer; access class; affected-party references; authority, activation, challenge, expiry, closure, unresolved-duty, and prohibited-inference fields; correction propagation where relied upon.

records.title: Complaint, Independent Review, Interim Relief, Correction, and Remedy Record
records.authority_effect_rule: Must be explicitly recorded; default is `advisory` or `record_support` unless a cited competent record supplies another effect.
records.purpose: Provides accessible complaint, ombuds, review, interim relief, evidence, reasons, appeal, correction propagation, restitution, compensation, rehabilitation, non-repetition, and protection against retaliation.
records.minimum_controls: human accountable officer; access class; affected-party references; authority, activation, challenge, expiry, closure, unresolved-duty, and prohibited-inference fields; correction propagation where relied upon.

records.title: Expiry, Termination, Closure, Authority Return, Support Withdrawal, Asset and Data Disposition
records.authority_effect_rule: Must be explicitly recorded; default is `advisory` or `record_support` unless a cited competent record supplies another effect.
records.purpose: Ends temporary authority, stops operations, withdraws exceptional support safely, returns assets and credentials, preserves essential functions, settles contracts and wages, assigns unresolved duties, completes data disposition, records ordinary-owner or closure status, and distinguishes closed from closed-with-unresolved-duties.
records.minimum_controls: human accountable officer; access class; affected-party references; authority, activation, challenge, expiry, closure, unresolved-duty, and prohibited-inference fields; correction propagation where relied upon.

records.title: Framework, Tool Core, Fork, Compatibility Power, Version, Deprecation, Falsification, and Stewardship Record
records.authority_effect_rule: Must be explicitly recorded; default is `advisory` or `record_support` unless a cited competent record supplies another effect.
records.purpose: Governs changes to the framework and tool library through public proposals, compatibility and rights review, maintainers, common-mode and objective-reproduction review, security patches, migration, local forks, deprecation, theory of change, disconfirming evidence, narrowing, suspension, replacement, archive, and the prohibition on silent expansion of authority.
records.minimum_controls: human accountable officer; access class; affected-party references; authority, activation, challenge, expiry, closure, unresolved-duty, and prohibited-inference fields; correction propagation where relied upon.

readiness_gates.requirement: Framework declares non-authority and exact adoption state
Controlling versions, hashes, migration status, and retired registries are explicit
Principal, objective, scope, pilot type, and claimed causal mechanism identified
Support roles separated from approval and decision roles
Local-equivalent facilitators and complaints available
Engagement is voluntary where claimed and exit is safe
Stage 0 does not covertly assess or intervene
Affected outsiders and transboundary effects mapped
Affected Indigenous nation controls its representatives and consent
Accessibility and independent participation support funded
Assessment purpose, prohibited uses, and administrative burden declared
Conditions profile is multidimensional and non-dispositive
Responsibility follows causal control, jurisdiction, capacity, and resources; affected standing does not assign responsibility
Upstream controllers, shared authority, capacity limits, and constitutional gaps identified
Recommendations are advisory, challengeable, and may include an Impossible Pilot Notice
Every tool states authority effect, pilot claims, consequence triggers, and protected-domain flags
Tool stack exposes causal dependencies, cumulative complexity, administrative burden, and common-mode risk
Local adaptation does not require external ideological approval
Compatibility does not become practical legitimacy, funding worth, or cultural conformity by implication
Ethics and cultural reviews are advisory
Protected domains fail closed through the specialized interface
Consent and public-law authority are separated
Exact authority, authority formation, jurisdiction, and causal envelope verified
Trial authorization separated from adoption and activation
EGP effect label and authority envelope used
Funding, deployment, repository inclusion, and compatibility cannot activate
Essential services and continuing duties protected
Data and dashboards cannot dispose rights, funding, causal truth, or institutionalization
AI has prohibited-decision list, common-mode review, and accountable owner
Metrics trigger review rather than scaling or permanent adoption
Learning artifacts protect consent, sources, withdrawal, and sample-limit disclosure
Pilot type is explicit and success claims do not exceed the tested question
Pilot is minimally causally adequate or is redesigned, narrowed, routed upstream, or marked impossible
`CP0`–`CP3` consequence profile is selected and core-plus-trigger documentation justified
Common-mode independence is assessed for high-consequence implementations
Implementation-ecology objective-reproduction review applies to long-lived or systemically important support arrangements
Response-duty source, clocks, GMEAIA states, custody, safe-state reference, and escalation are recorded for consequential handoffs
`capacity_limited` remains distinct from `constitutional_gap`
Timeout, silence, technical receipt, and compatibility do not transfer jurisdiction
Scaling requires new authority and affected-party review
Permanent adoption identifies ordinary owner, mandate, budget, staff, maintenance, and support withdrawal
Repeated pilots state what evidence remains missing and why transition, rejection, or structural action is not next
Expiry, remedy, closure, data disposition, support withdrawal, and authority return complete
Framework-level theory of change, disconfirming evidence, narrowing, suspension, replacement, and non-scaling conditions published
No claim of compatibility with the retired `IAEG-CLUSTER/0.1`; successor machine-readable adoption is pending

compound_tests.scenario: Community requests help selecting a meeting method
compound_tests.required_outcome: PASS when the tool is advisory, locally adaptable, and carries no authority effect.

compound_tests.scenario: Catalyst Team reaches out to a community that declines
compound_tests.required_outcome: PASS when no profile is created beyond minimum contact and no support or standing is lost.

compound_tests.scenario: Community Weaver maps informal leaders during meals
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL CLOSED unless purpose, consent, protection, and non-use for representative selection are recorded.

compound_tests.scenario: Conditions profile labels a community Low
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL: scalar competence ranking is non-conformant.

compound_tests.scenario: Low resource capacity triggers a seed grant
compound_tests.required_outcome: PASS only through separate funding authority; it creates no implementation permission.

compound_tests.scenario: Conditions score automatically routes grant amount
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL: prohibited automated disposition and absent funding decision.

compound_tests.scenario: External Indigenous representative approves a local adaptation
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL: cannot substitute for the affected Indigenous nation.

compound_tests.scenario: Affected nation declines to use EGP records
compound_tests.required_outcome: PASS: its law and chosen records control; non-use causes no penalty.

compound_tests.scenario: Ethics panel rejects a lawful local adaptation
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL if rejection is treated as binding; panel may publish concerns and seek review.

compound_tests.scenario: Tool Stack includes only voluntary workshop tools
compound_tests.required_outcome: PASS with an appropriate `CP0` or `CP1` core, informed participation, accessibility, and closure.

compound_tests.scenario: A charter template is treated as creating a council
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL: template has record-support effect only; lawful constitution is separate.

compound_tests.scenario: A pilot affects municipal traffic
compound_tests.required_outcome: PASS only after municipal authority, authorization, activation, notice, safety review, and rollback.

compound_tests.scenario: A pilot changes household water access
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL CLOSED as protected essential service without controlling water and rights authority.

compound_tests.scenario: A pilot uses a 72-hour emergency activation kit
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL unless linked to accepted CDEE/ECRC mission and competent command.

compound_tests.scenario: Local rescue team acts under pre-existing rescue law
compound_tests.required_outcome: PASS if authority, mission, scope, safety, clocks, and review are recorded.

compound_tests.scenario: EGP adoption record is signed and code deployed
compound_tests.required_outcome: REMAINS INACTIVE until `IAF-31` activation.

compound_tests.scenario: Funder releases grant before authorization
compound_tests.required_outcome: Funding may exist, but operation remains inactive.

compound_tests.scenario: Participant withdraws from a voluntary pilot
compound_tests.required_outcome: PASS when participation and optional data end without retaliation or essential-service loss.

compound_tests.scenario: Community majority tries to bind non-resident workers
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL unless lawful authority and affected-worker rights and participation exist.

compound_tests.scenario: Tool Finder AI recommends a talking circle
compound_tests.required_outcome: PASS as advisory assistance without profiling or consequential routing.

compound_tests.scenario: AI marks an ethics review passed and activates the pilot
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL: prohibited automated approval and activation.

compound_tests.scenario: Dashboard trust score falls below 75%
compound_tests.required_outcome: Triggers review only; no automatic funding loss or shutdown.

compound_tests.scenario: Pilot exceeds a target and moves to Band 4
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL if automatic; band is complexity only and scaling requires `IAF-44`.

compound_tests.scenario: Successful pilot informs a new municipal ordinance
compound_tests.required_outcome: PASS when ordinary enactment creates the law and EGP only records it.

compound_tests.scenario: Failure Library publishes a participant story
compound_tests.required_outcome: PASS only with specific publication consent, review, withdrawal, and safety protection.

compound_tests.scenario: Whistleblower evidence is included in an Adaptation Report
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL public release; use protected source handling and separated learning artifact.

compound_tests.scenario: Anonymized report is re-identifiable in a small community
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL until disclosure risk and community controls are resolved.

compound_tests.scenario: Paper consent conflicts with app consent
compound_tests.required_outcome: Neither wins automatically; offline parity and correction process apply.

compound_tests.scenario: Facilitator lacks GGF certification but has local mandate
compound_tests.required_outcome: PASS if qualification and local-equivalence requirements are met.

compound_tests.scenario: Certified facilitator has a financial conflict
compound_tests.required_outcome: Requires disclosure, recusal, substitute, complaint, and possible removal.

compound_tests.scenario: Funder requires MOS adherence for translation support
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL: participation support cannot depend on ideological conformity.

compound_tests.scenario: Pilot funding is suspended for misuse
compound_tests.required_outcome: Requires separate reasons, evidence, proportionality, appeal, worker and essential-function safeguards.

compound_tests.scenario: Crisis signal is sent to regional coordinator
compound_tests.required_outcome: It is a CDEE referral, not an emergency declaration or mission acceptance.

compound_tests.scenario: Receiving framework never accepts a handoff
compound_tests.required_outcome: Sender retains custody and duty; no action or silent transfer occurs.

compound_tests.scenario: Pilot expires with unpaid worker wages
compound_tests.required_outcome: Authority ends, but wage and remedy duties remain open.

compound_tests.scenario: Framework update silently gives Catalyst Team approval power
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL: material authority expansion requires new constitutional adoption and version.

compound_tests.scenario: A voluntary workshop is required to complete the full protected-domain record set
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL as over-administration; choose `CP0` or `CP1` and trigger only materially relevant records.

compound_tests.scenario: An acceptability pilot is cited as proof that a policy improves system outcomes
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL: the claim exceeds the pilot type.

compound_tests.scenario: The smallest reversible pilot excludes the proposed causal mechanism
compound_tests.required_outcome: REDESIGN, narrow the question, route upstream, or issue an Impossible Pilot Notice.

compound_tests.scenario: A local community is blamed for failure caused by an upstream law or infrastructure owner
compound_tests.required_outcome: FAIL: causal responsibility remains with the controlling actor and shared duties are recorded.

compound_tests.scenario: Catalyst Team supports only tools it maintains and funders treat that catalogue as eligibility
compound_tests.required_outcome: REQUIRES compatibility-power and objective-reproduction review; essential support cannot depend on catalogue conformity.

compound_tests.scenario: Grant-funded pilot succeeds but no ordinary budget, owner, or maintenance capacity exists
compound_tests.required_outcome: Record bounded pilot success; do not claim institutionalization or durability.

compound_tests.scenario: A fifth pilot repeats substantially the same mechanism without addressing transition
compound_tests.required_outcome: REQUIRES repeated-pilot review and reasons why transition, rejection, or structural action is not next.

compound_tests.scenario: Recipient accepts jurisdiction but lacks staff and finance
compound_tests.required_outcome: Use `capacity_limited`; identify support and action clocks. Do not label a constitutional gap.

compound_tests.scenario: Recipient misses the response deadline
compound_tests.required_outcome: Use `timed_out`; escalate and preserve custody. No jurisdiction transfers automatically.

compound_tests.scenario: Assessor, tool recommender, evaluator, and learning synthesizer use one AI provider and funder
compound_tests.required_outcome: Common-mode review and fallback or explicit risk acceptance are required.

compound_tests.scenario: A local fork is technically incompatible with the GGF tool stack
compound_tests.required_outcome: State the precise compatibility effect and migration route; incompatibility does not establish illegitimacy.

compound_tests.scenario: Comparative evidence shows the IAF layer adds delay and burden without improving fit, safety, or outcomes
compound_tests.required_outcome: Narrow, simplify, suspend, replace, or stop scaling the relevant mechanism.

framework_hypotheses.title: Context-sensitive selection improves fit
framework_hypotheses.hypothesis: conditions and causal profiles materially improve tool choice, safety, inclusion, or outcomes compared with generic implementation.
framework_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: profiles mostly restate known facts, do not change decisions, or add burden without improved fit.

framework_hypotheses.title: Constitutional separation prevents overreach without defeating action
framework_hypotheses.hypothesis: separating consent, authority, authorization, adoption, activation, and scaling reduces unauthorized action while preserving timely response.
framework_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: compliant implementations routinely miss decision windows, stall in handoffs, or abandon useful action because the chain is too slow.

framework_hypotheses.title: Local adaptation improves effectiveness and legitimacy
framework_hypotheses.hypothesis: local forks increase relevance and ownership without eroding rights or making learning unusable.
framework_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: adaptation is cosmetic, compatibility becomes shadow governance, or local forks receive materially inferior support without safety justification.

framework_hypotheses.title: Causally adequate bounded pilots produce valid learning
framework_hypotheses.hypothesis: bounded pilots expose enough of the mechanism to support honest decisions.
framework_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: pilots repeatedly succeed in protected conditions and fail at the mechanism, scale, or political transition excluded from the test.

framework_hypotheses.title: Proportional process reduces both risk and bureaucracy
framework_hypotheses.hypothesis: `CP0`–`CP3` core-plus-trigger profiles reduce over-administration without under-governing consequential action.
framework_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: low-risk work still requires specialist-heavy records, or consequential harms arise because required triggers were omitted.

framework_hypotheses.title: Support builds autonomy rather than dependency
framework_hypotheses.hypothesis: Catalyst, facilitator, funder, vendor, and AI support increase local capacity to maintain, adapt, fork, replace, or close.
framework_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: pilots collapse when exceptional support ends or local actors remain dependent on the original implementation ecology.

framework_hypotheses.title: Learning improves future implementation
framework_hypotheses.hypothesis: bounded learning changes later tool selection and reduces repeated failure.
framework_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: libraries are biased, unused, dominated by publishable success, or disconnected from decisions.

framework_hypotheses.title: Transition architecture reduces permanent-pilot accumulation
framework_hypotheses.hypothesis: ordinary-owner and repeated-pilot requirements move useful functions into durable provision and terminate unsupported experiments.
framework_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: pilot volume grows while transition rates remain low and the same mechanisms are repeatedly retested.

release_doctrine: Implementation support may make action more understandable, feasible, reversible, and learnable. It cannot make an action lawful, legitimate, authorized, causally effective, transferable, scalable, or durable by declaration or schema conformance.
